theme_central: Establishing pure Tawhid through a gallery of prophets united by the same refrain of peace — culminating in the sacrifice of Isma'il, Ibrahim's most intense trial.
sources_note: Precisely sourced division (thequran.love, Abraham's Dream and Ishmael's Sacrifice): 1-11, 12-70, 75-148, with the Ibrahim/Isma'il narrative detailed in 83-113.

branches.title: Opening, oath of the angels
branches.resume: Triple rhythmic oath by the angels ranged in rows, who drive forth, who recite.

children.t: Oath by the angels ranged in rows; oneness of Allah, Lord of the heavens, the earth and the East

branches.title: Scene of the Judgment
branches.resume: Terrible fate and mutual reproaches of the polytheists, bliss of the believers in Paradise.

children.t: Mockery of the disbelievers toward the resurrection, terrible fate awaiting them
Bliss of the believers in Paradise, dialogue with a disbelieving companion
The tree of Zaqqum, food of the damned in Hell

branches.title: Nuh
branches.resume: His long struggle, his supplication answered, salvation of his believing family.

children.t: Nuh's supplication answered, salvation of the ark, "Peace upon Nuh among the worlds"

branches.title: Ibrahim and the sacrifice of Isma'il
branches.resume: The longest prophetic narrative in the surah: confrontation with idolatry, then the sacrifice ordered in a dream.

children.t: Ibrahim breaks the idols, thrown into a fire that becomes cool and safe
The dream of sacrifice, the son's submission, ransom by the ram sent from heaven
"Peace upon Ibrahim", announcement of Ishaq as a prophet

branches.title: Musa, Ilyas, Yunus
branches.resume: Musa and Harun saved, Ilyas against the worship of Ba'l, Yunus swallowed then cast out by the fish.

children.t: Musa and Harun, "Peace upon Musa and Harun"
Ilyas calls his people to abandon the worship of Ba'l
Yunus swallowed by the fish, his repentance, restored to his mission

branches.title: Refutation, closing
branches.resume: Refutation of attributing daughters to Allah, promise of victory to the messengers, final praise.

children.t: Refutation of attributing daughters to Allah and jinn as partners
Promise of final victory granted to the messengers
Closing: glory to the Lord of might, peace upon the messengers, praise to Allah
